race.comment: HIGHLAND HUSTLE (11) is not a noted first-up performer but did a good job when fresh from a four-month break last start, beaten less than a length over 1400m at Coffs Harbour. Better placed over the mile so she looks a great chance to go one better. STAR OF WINSTON (17) came off a 44-day let-up and made it three wins from his last four runs when he accounted for HIGHLAND HUSTLE at Coffs recently. Loves Grafton and will have no issue with this longer trip. Hard to knock on what he has produced of late. COSMIC COCO (6) failed over 1900m on the Gold Coast poly last time out in a run worth overlooking. Better placed today and gets a nice run from the good gate. Last start Coffs Harbour maiden winner BRAVO SIX (5) is progressing nicely now and looks ready to tackle a race like this. HIGHWIRE GIRL (12) is racing well and will be at her peak now after three runs back from a spell.
